//: A deeply nested function is flattened with every result and error kept the same.
title: cost() nests at most two deep and gives the same result for every input

argv:
import ast
import pathlib

NESTS = (ast.If, ast.For, ast.While, ast.With, ast.Try)


def depth(node, level=0):
    deepest = level
    for field, value in ast.iter_fields(node):
        for child in value if isinstance(value, list) else [value]:
            if not isinstance(child, ast.AST):
                continue
            # An else that holds only an if is an elif, which nests no deeper.
            elif_ = isinstance(node, ast.If) and field == 'orelse' and len(value) == 1 and isinstance(child, ast.If)
            deepest = max(deepest, depth(child, level + (isinstance(child, NESTS) and not elif_)))
    return deepest


tree = ast.parse(pathlib.Path('shipping.py').read_text())
cost = next(node for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == 'cost')
assert depth(cost) <= 2, f'cost() still nests {depth(cost)} deep'
